findings.evidence: validate() checks the clipped layer (canonical fields, has_base via any() over earlier unclipped layers, own mode not GroupOnly) but never the BASE's mode. Reviewer re-checked.

findings.evidence: Claim 'hidden base drops the run' not honoured in evaluate. The hidden base sets have_base and is skipped, but a visible clipped child under it that is Unavailable (e.g. appearance_block 'clipped_with_mask_unsupported', evaluate_static.rs:203) still sets blocked='input_unavailable' on the parent. Lowering skips the clipped child (base_visible Some(false)) but then refuses because the reachable parent's status is Unavailable. Same doc with an available clipped child lowers to an empty root. Typed over-refusal, not wrong pixels. Reviewer re-checked.
findings.remediation: In evaluate, skip status/extent of clipped inputs whose base is hidden or empty, mirroring the lowering base rule

findings.evidence: abort is set only after the delivery loop. If TileSink::accept panics (or a worker panics so its chunk never arrives), workers with index >= delivered+window loop in wait_timeout forever and thread::scope never returns: the parallel path hangs where the serial path propagates the panic. Reviewer re-checked loop and abort placement.
findings.remediation: Set abort+notify_all from an unwind guard; catch_unwind in workers and send Message::Failed

findings.evidence: Per-pixel coverage runs winding queries over the whole path (up to 256 samples x 65536 elements per pixel of a 4096^2 chunk); cancel/deadline are polled only between chunks, so one hostile vector chunk can overrun the deadline by hours. Work is not charged at prepare.
findings.remediation: Bound elements*samples*pixels at prepare or poll cancel/deadline per row

findings.evidence: Public Residency::reserve computes self.used + bytes unchecked.
